### Revenue Growth  
NVIDIA is experiencing extraordinary revenue growth, with a 68.3% CAGR from 2022 to 2027, and revenue more than quadrupling from $26.9B in 2022 to an estimated $249.95B by 2027. The most rapid expansion occurs between 2023 and 2026, driven by surging demand in AI and data center segments, though growth is projected to normalize to single digits post-2025.

### Gross Profit Margin  
NVIDIA’s gross profit margin (as represented by contribution margin) rebounded sharply from 56.9% in 2023 to 75.0% in 2025, indicating significant pricing power and operational leverage. Margins are expected to remain robust, stabilizing above 70% through 2027, reflecting continued dominance in high-value markets.

### SG&A Expense Margin  
SG&A expense as a percentage of revenue is on a steep downward trend, dropping from 9.0% in 2023 to just 0.6% by 2027. This demonstrates impressive operating efficiency and scalability, as fixed costs are spread over a rapidly expanding revenue base.

### EBITDA Margin  
EBITDA margins have improved dramatically, rising from 22.2% in 2023 to an estimated 73.5% by 2027. This margin expansion outpaces peers (AMD and INTC), underlining NVIDIA’s exceptional profitability and its ability to convert top-line growth into bottom-line performance.
